data.name: Arefin
data.gender_notes: Arefin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who possesses extensive knowledge and intelligence. The name Arefin carries the meaning “Knowledgeable, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Arefin usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A seeker of truth and knowledge in the divine realm
data.etymology: Arefin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledgeable, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arefin total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عريفن
in_arabic.long_meaning: يعني عريفن العبد المولى رفيقاً متميزاً لربه، ويشير إلى الرفيق المتميز بالعبادة والطاعة، ويكون هذا الرفيق متميزاً بالخير والمجد، ويكون له مقام رفيع في قلوب المؤمنين، ويشير إلى الإخلاص والصدق، ويكون ذلك الرفيق متميزاً بالعلم والهداية، ويكون له دور رفيع في التوجيه والمارشية.

in_urdu.name: عریفن
in_urdu.meaning: یہ نام رفیق کے نام کے ساتھ متمیز ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عریفن ایک نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ایک رفیق جو اپنے رب کے ساتھ متمیز ہے، یہ نام عبادت اور اطاعت کے ساتھ منسلک ہے۔ یہ نام ہندوستان میں مسلمانوں کی روایات میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अरेफिन

in_hindi.long_meaning: अरेफिन एक नाम है जिसका अर्थ है अपने मालिक के साथ एक विशिष्ट साथी। यह नाम ईश्वरीय प्रेम के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عریفن
in_pashto.long_meaning: عریفن یو ځانګړی رفیق دی چې د رب د ساتنې لاندې دی، دا ځانګړی رفیق د خپل رب د ساتنې لاندې دی چې په عبادت او اطاعت کې دی، داسې رفیق یو ځانګړی دی چې په ګوڼو او شرف کې دی، په افغانستان کې دا نوم تېرو سلوکونو کې راغلی دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Arefin holds significant prestige and appeal in the Islamic community due to its association with knowledge and intelligence. In a culture that values education and intellectual pursuits, bearing a name like Arefin can confer a sense of pride and distinction. In many Muslim societies, scholars and intellectuals are highly respected, and thus, the name Arefin can evoke positive associations with learning, wisdom, and academic success.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Arefin lies in its connection to knowledge as a means to seek closeness to Allah. In Islamic teachings, knowledge and wisdom are considered essential for leading a virtuous life and pleasing Allah. By granting someone the name Arefin, parents may be expressing their hope that their child will grow up to become a seeker of knowledge and wisdom, drawn closer to Allah through the pursuit of intellectual pursuits.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Arefin in Islamic tradition symbolizes one who is 'pursuing knowledge and perfection' in both the material and spiritual realms. It is a reminder to strive for excellence in all aspects of life, following the example of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Arefin was a famous Persian scholar and philosopher of the 12th century. He wrote numerous works on various subjects, including logic, mathematics, and metaphysics. One of his most influential works is 'Gorghistan', which is a collection of logical and philosophical essays.

Arefin al-Jabali (d. 1153) was a prominent Andalusian scholar and philosopher in the 12th century. He was born in Granada and studied under Ibn Rushd (Averroes). Arefin is known for his commentary on Aristotle's 'Nicomachean Ethics' and his influence on Latin scholasticism through his works being translated into Latin.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Arefin' has modern relevance in the context of Islamic personal development and spiritual growth. It is seen on various platforms, including mobile apps such as 'Arefin Daily' which provides daily Islamic quotes and reflections, social media channels like 'Arefin Community' where users can connect and learn from one another, and online courses offered by institutes such as 'Arefin Academy'. The general trend is towards utilizing technology to make Islamic teachings accessible, engaging, and convenient for individuals seeking spiritual growth and self-improvement.
